title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 5, section 7 (Englishman River)

source.version: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026

source_text:
Schedule 5 No Shooting Areas (Section 6)
Englishman River
7 That portion of the Province of British Columbia in the vicinity of the Village of Parksville, Nanoose Land District, which is contained within the following described boundaries: Commencing at the northeast corner of Lot 1, Nanoose Land District, being a point on the high water mark on the Strait of Georgia; thence southerly along the easterly boundaries of Lots 1, 96 and 129 to the point of intersection, on the easterly boundary of said Lot 129, with the centreline of Island Highway 19, Registered Plan 812 R/W; thence in a generally westerly direction along said centreline to the point of intersection with the centreline of the Englishman River; thence in a generally northerly direction along the centreline of the main channel of said Englishman River to a point due West of the most westerly part of Lot 9, Plan 19158, Lot 181; thence due East to a point on the high water mark of the Strait of Georgia, being the westerly extremity of said Lot 9, Plan 19158; thence in a generally easterly direction along the high water mark of the Strait of Georgia, being the northerly boundary of Lot 181 (all lots herein above mentioned, beginning with Lot 1, being in the Nanoose District) to the northeast corner of Lot 1, Nanoose District, being point of commencement.
